classification.difficultyReason: Plot each original-image pair and determine the horizontal and vertical displacement, counting the vertical movement across zero in the second pair.

content.prompt: Given the following points and their images under a translation, plot each point and describe the translation.

answer.worked: On the plotted grid, $A'$ is 1 unit to the right and 3 units above $A$. The translation is 1 unit right and 3 units up.
On the plotted grid, $B'$ is 1 unit to the right of $B$. Moving from $y=-2$ to $y=4$ is 6 units up. The translation is 1 unit right and 6 units up.

spec.description: Complete graph of A, A′, B and B′.
